{{Quote|For details and prices, consult any INCOM dealer or contact: INCOM Corp. Customer Service Bureau, NW Coromon Island 102, Fresia LLK231.|[[Introducing Incom's T-65 "X-Wing" Space Superiority Fighter|Incom advertisement]]|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''INCOM Corp. Customer Service Bureau''' was a part of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. It was located at [[NW Coromon Island 102]], in the [[Northwest Coromons]] island chain on [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]].<ref name="RPG" /> Incom facilities were spread throughout the larger [[Coromon Islands]] group.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Customers wishing to inquire about Incom products, prices and deals were referred to contact the Customer Service Bureau to handle their queries.<ref name="RPG" />
